title: MechaEagles founded

title: Divisions and subteams

title: Four engineering teams

title: NASA Student Launch proposal

title: First high-power launch day
detail: Three rockets flown, two recovered, one Level 1 certification earned.

title: First launch day: three up, two back
detail: Jack Tommaney, Lucas DiMarco and Vedarsh Mishra took three rockets to the field for the team's first high-power outing. All three left the rail cleanly, and two were recovered. AeroEagle-1, on an AeroTech H100W, flew strongly on ascent, but its parachute didn't deploy as intended and it landed beyond the search area. Because it wasn't retrieved, the team records this as a recovery-system failure rather than guessing at a component. Jack Tommaney earned Level 1 certification on the day.
lessons: Keep the model-to-test loop: predict the flight, fly it, compare, update the next design.
Verify deployment logic, hardware, packing and triggers independently before every flight.
Record the complete flight-ready configuration before launch.
Add a tracker or beacon so a rocket that drifts can still be found.
